prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1094; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection and began a left turn when the front of the vehicle struck the driver's side of Driver 2's vehicle, which was proceeding straight. Driver 2 was the one who reported a wrist fracture at the scene, and Driver 2 was seated in the vehicle when officers arrived, a fact confirmed by the responding officer and by witnesses who saw the vehicle before and after the impact. A Passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was not injured. Two independent witnesses on the sidewalk and the other driver each gave accounts that match the sequence of events described here, and scene photographs show damage to the front of Driver 1's vehicle and the driver's side of Driver 2's vehicle, consistent with that impact. Officers found no sign of earlier damage to either vehicle. Driver 2 is a member of Driver 1's household and is listed as covered under Driver 1's policy as a household member. At this time it is not yet clear whether the reported wrist injury resulted from this collision, and the medical evaluation is pending.
